status: DRAFT: prompts and assertions only; needs golden-run fixtures (runs with known values) so findings can be checked against actual numbers; with-vs-without runs on Claude Code and Codex not done; schema to be checked against the NVIDIA skills guide

evals.prompt: My Gym GPQA score is 5 points below the model card. Both run directories are attached. Is it a real regression?
evals.expected_output: Quantifies noise first (repeat counts, standard error, interval), then checks code, data, method, failure accounting and health; ends with within noise, explained or not yet explained and one evidence-backed finding.
assertions: computes or reads the standard error before calling the gap real
checks failure accounting (scored vs materialized inputs)
ends with one of: within noise, explained, not yet explained
files: FIXTURE_NEEDED: two small run directories with known aggregate metrics

evals.prompt: Compare results/baseline and results/candidate (8 repeats each, same agent) and tell me whether the candidate is better.
evals.expected_output: Runs gym eval compare with --baseline, --candidates, --output-dir, reads the interval and the flipped tasks, reports the delta with its interval.
assertions: uses gym eval compare, not a hand-computed difference
reports the delta together with its confidence interval
lists tasks that flipped between pass and fail

evals.prompt: Which tasks does the model fail in results/run1, and why? Give me a short report.
evals.expected_output: Counts tasks, rollouts and missing rows; computes pass@1 and pass@k; buckets always, sometimes, never pass and missing; labels failures with one primary cause each; recommends one action per cause; cites row counts and task ids.
assertions: buckets tasks into always-pass, sometimes-pass, never-pass and missing
cites task ids or row counts for each claim
uses one primary cause label per failure
does not invent evidence for missing artifacts
files: FIXTURE_NEEDED: run with a known failure mix
